messages:
maria: Hey team — small docs PR incoming: adding a minimal example for tool-calling fallbacks + a compact JSON output example. Want a quick pre-check list so I don't miss any link updates or SDK snippets.

sam: thanks! can you include a tiny test prompt and the expected parse shape? reviewers love concrete pass/fail checks.

maria: yea planning to add this: 
```
User: 'Check price of item 12345'
Assistant -> tool: get_price(item_id=12345)
Tool returns: {"price_cents": 1999, "currency": "USD"}
Assistant -> reply: {"price_display": "$19.99"}
```
Keep it as compact as possible.

jake: pls show both the schema and the fallback behavior when the tool returns null or errors. Example: schema for tool output + a small shim to coerce null -> {"price_cents": null}.

olivia: +1. Also add a short note for SDK users about `response.parse()` vs manually pulling from `resp.output` — we've had confusion there. A one-line snippet in JS and Python would be nice.

maria: draft JS snippet: 
```js
const out = await client.responses.create({ model: 'x', input: prompt })
// prefer parser utility to validate structured output
const parsed = Responses.parseStructured(out) // pseudo-API for docs
if (!parsed.price_cents) { /* fallback handling */ }
```

sam: for the docs linter: remember to use the canonical internal link for the schema guide (docs/schema-best-practices) instead of a relative path. I'll paste the link in the PR description.

maria: thanks — will link to docs/schema-best-practices and docs/tool-fallbacks. Also will add an anchors.md entry for the new example so the cross-ref test doesn't fail.

docbot: deploy-bot posted: "Docs staging build started for PR #3246"

jake: reviewer note: prefer using a compact JSON schema example (one-liner) like: 
```
{"type":"object","properties":{"price_cents":{"type":["integer","null"]},"currency":{"type":"string"}},"required":["currency"]}
```
and then include a short sentence about why price_cents can be null.

olivia: also check the SDK snippet types: Python example should show typing import and the small validation call.

maria: OK will add both. I plan to keep the thread in this PR and do a followup ticket for expanded runbook examples. Anything else?

sam: add a tiny eval (one prompt + expected parsed result) in the PR so the QA checks can run. E.g. prompt -> expected {"price_display": "$19.99"}.

maria: noted. I'll also run the snippet sanitizer script (`./scripts/sanitize-snippets.sh`) before pushing.

jake: if you can, squash commits into logical steps: example, schema, sdk-snippets, links. Makes review faster.

maria: will do. pushing in ~30m. thanks! :thumbsup:

docbot: docs-ci: "staging build passed (lint + linkcheck) for PR #3246"

olivia: awesome — tagging for review: @sam @jake.

sam: grabbing review shortly.

jake: small nit after review: please reword the guardrails blurb to avoid implying the runtime enforces the schema — it's user-side parsing/validation.

maria: fixed wording & pushed. final CI green. closing PR after merge.

sam: thanks for the quick turnaround.

maria: np — I'll open the followup with more examples next week.
